name: inline-math
description: Draws the LaTeX in Claude's replies as typeset pictures, inline with the terminal text and on its baseline (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty; tmux with passthrough), and mermaid code blocks as Unicode diagrams

enabled.title: Draw formulas
enabled.description: Draw LaTeX in replies as pictures. /inline-math on|off overrides this and is kept across sessions.

foreground.title: Formula colour
foreground.description: "auto" follows the desktop's light or dark scheme (Catppuccin Latte / Mocha text), or a colour as #rrggbb.

cell.title: Cell size in pixels
cell.description: "auto" asks tmux or the terminal; else WIDTHxHEIGHT of one character cell, such as 19x42.

baseline.title: Text baseline
baseline.description: Where the font's baseline sits in a cell, from the top, as a fraction of the cell height (JetBrains Mono: 0.773).

ptPx.title: Formula scale
ptPx.description: Pixels per TeX point. Larger draws bigger formulas; 3.4 matches a 12 pt terminal font at 42 px cells.

minShrink.title: Smallest inline scale
minShrink.description: How far an inline formula may shrink to stay on one text row before it takes more rows (0.8 = 80%).

promptHint.title: Tell Claude about it
promptHint.description: Add a short note to the system prompt: write math as $...$ and $$...$$, never in code blocks; mermaid blocks draw as diagrams.

packages.title: Extra LaTeX packages
packages.description: TeX Live packages to load for every formula, separated by commas or spaces (such as "physics, tensor"). Built into the precompiled format; trusted as you give them.

macros.title: Your LaTeX macros
macros.description: Your own definitions (\newcommand, \DeclareMathOperator, ...), one or more lines, available in every formula. Built into the precompiled format; trusted as you give them.

diagramColor.title: Coloured diagrams
diagramColor.description: Draw mermaid diagrams with Catppuccin accent colours for boxes and lines (Latte or Mocha, following the light or dark scheme). Off: the text colour alone.
